subject.title: Explore deterministic profiling gates for Crabbox runs

question: Should Crabbox sponsor a narrow deterministic perf-gate MVP now, and if so which runtime, metric, and workload boundary should be accepted for the first implementation?
rationale: Current main documents the desired contract but intentionally lacks the budget flag, fuel timing field, metered backend, and runtime trust model, so automation cannot choose the product/API direction safely.

options.title: Keep As Design Canonical
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical product/security decision until a proving workload and runtime boundary are selected.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow MVP
options.body: Approve one deterministic metric and one WASI/wasmtime-style backend so a focused implementation PR can add flags, timing JSON, capability gating, and tests.

options.title: Stop At Docs Contract
options.body: Declare the merged documentation sufficient and defer runtime-backed perf gates indefinitely.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Canonical
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical product/security decision until a proving workload and runtime boundary are selected.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete provided the current consolidation comment and is tied to current-main history on the affected docs and core run surfaces.
